deep.reconstruction:
Context. The previous page ends with the series lz - z^4/10 + z^8/300 - ..., i.e. log of the lemniscatic sine: sl z = z - z^5/10 + ... gives log(1 - z^4/10 + ...) = -z^4/10 + (1/120 - 1/200) z^8 = -z^4/10 + z^8/300. It also gives a companion series lQ = z^4/12 - z^8/280 + z^12/4950 - z^16/78000 + 41/(342.221.625) z^20. Note that 342.221.625 = 13.17.18.19.625.

The z^20 coefficient was being assembled there as a signed sum of rational terms:
41/(13.17.18.19.625), 1/(72000.13), 1/(8000.11.7.81), 408/(12!.280) and 13584/(16!.12).
This page converts these terms to a common denominator and multiplies out the numerators.

(1) Common denominator (top line):
D = 19.17.13.11.7.5^4.3^6.2^13 = 20!/2016 (since 20! = 2^18 3^8 5^4 7^2 11.13.17.19 and 2016 = 2^5 3^2 7). This matches '1...20/2016' on the previous page.

(2) Term 41/(13.17.18.19.625):
- D/(2.3^2.5^4.13.17.19) = 7.11.3^4.2^12, so the numerator is 41.77.81.4096.
- Right column: 8.41 = 328; 81.41 = 3321; 11.3321 = 36531; 7.36531 = 255717.
- Then 4.255717 = 1022868; 96.255717 = 24548832; 1024.1022868 = 1047416832.
- So 41.77.81.4096 = 1047416832.

(3) Term 1/(72000.13), with 72000 = 2^6 3^2 5^3:
- D/(2^6 3^2 5^3 13) = 19.17.11.7.5.81.128.
- Steps: 19.17 = 323; .11 = 3553; .7 = 24871. The line 198968 = 8.24871 is a stray.
- Then 81.24871 = 2014551; .8 = 16116408; .8 = 128931264; .10 = 1289312640.
- The side note '8000.11.7.81' recalls the next term's denominator.

(4) Term 1/(8000.11.7.81), with 8000 = 2^6 5^3:
- D/(2^6 5^3 7.11.3^4) = 19.17.13.5.9.128.
- Steps: 323; 3.323 = 969; 13.323 = 4199; 9.4199 = 37791; 8.37791 = 302328; 80.302328 = 24186240.

(5) Term 408/(12!.280), with 12!.280 = 2^13 3^5 5^3 7^2 11 (not written out; my identification):
- D.408/(12!.280) = 408.3.5.13.17.19/7 = 6120.4199/7.
- Steps: 2.4199 = 8398; 102.4199 = 428298; .3 = 1284894; .20 = 25697880.
- Dividing by 7 gives 3671125 5/7. This is not an integer, because D contains only one factor 7.

(6) Term 13584/(16!.12), lower left:
- D.13584/(16!.12) = 13584.17.18.19.20/(12.2016) = 13584.17.19.30/2016.
- Steps: 3.13584 = 40752; 2.13584 = 27168; 323.13584 = 4387632; 30.4387632 = 131628960.
- Above, '17.18.19.20 / 6' with cancellations (18.20/12 = 30) shows how the factor 17.19.30 arises.
- The crossed scratch (51, 36, 1016, 7, 672, 42) appears to be an attempt to cancel against 2016.
- The exact value is 131628960/2016 = 457045/7 = 65292 1/7, again with residual 7 (my completion).
- Equivalently 13584/(16!.12) = 283/(2^13 3^6 5^3 7^2 11.13), the form that appears on the next page.

(7) Upper left summary: the numerators 1047416832, 1289312640, 24186240 and 3671125 5/7 are collected.

The fractional parts show that D must gain another factor 7. On the next page Gauss indeed redoes the sum over 2^13 3^6 5^3 7^2 11.13.17.19.

Purpose: an exact rational evaluation of the z^20 coefficient in the power series of the logarithm of a lemniscatic function (the S_k on the next page are k times the lQ coefficients).
errors: No arithmetic errors: every multiplication checks.

The provisional common denominator D lacks a second factor 7. As a result the numerators of the 408/(12!.280) and 13584/(16!.12) terms are non-integral (3671125 5/7 and 65292 1/7). Gauss evidently noticed this and enlarged the denominator to include 7^2 on the next page.
The line 198968 (= 8.24871) is not used in the chain; it is a stray partial product.

results.what: Exact rational computation (common denominator 20!/2016) of the z^20 Taylor coefficient of the logarithm of a lemniscatic function (series lz - z^4/10 + z^8/300 - ... and lQ = z^4/12 - z^8/280 + ...)
results.modern_name: Power series coefficients of log of the lemniscatic sine / related lemniscatic function (related to Eisenstein sums of the Gaussian lattice)
results.usually_credited_to: Gauss (lemniscatic function studies, c.1797-1800); series of elliptic functions later systematized by Abel, Jacobi, Eisenstein

results.what: Long multiplication of numerators over a common denominator

deep.surprise_reason: Pure arithmetic scratchwork supporting Gauss's well-documented lemniscatic series computations. The z^20 coefficient is a computational detail, not a new result.

checkable.asserts: Conversion of the first term to denominator D.
Simplified form of the 13584 term as on the next page.
Gives -x**4/10 + x**8/300, matching lz - z^4/10 + z^8/300 for log(sl z).
